description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kahawaththagama, Doluwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320034 (23/0946)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, ownership details, and encumbrances) by the Commissioner of Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registrations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters.
